heroes.name: Nowa
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — protagonis utama, anggota baru Eltisweiss Watch di Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — the main protagonist, a new member of the Eltisweiss Watch in Arenside.

heroes.name: Garr
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — bergabung di awal campaign di Arenside bersama Mio dan Lian.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — joins at the start of the campaign in Arenside alongside Mio and Lian.

heroes.name: Mio
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — bergabung di Arenside bersama Garr dan Lian.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — joins in Arenside alongside Garr and Lian.

heroes.name: Lian
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — bergabung di Arenside bersama Garr dan Mio.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — joins in Arenside alongside Garr and Mio.

heroes.name: Iugo
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di dalam rumah kecil di bagian timur kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — inside a small house in the eastern part of the city.

heroes.name: Mellore
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — temui dia saat keluar dari plaza Eltisweiss, lalu bantu dia mengalahkan boss Nerthus di Redthroat Ridge.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — meet her as you exit Eltisweiss plaza, then help her defeat the Nerthus boss at Redthroat Ridge.

heroes.name: Yume
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village/Redthroat Ridge — bicara dengan Old Lady di Werne Village, lalu cari dia di Redthroat Ridge bersama teman monsternya.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village/Redthroat Ridge — talk to the Old Lady in Werne Village, then find her at Redthroat Ridge with her monster pal.
heroes.notes_id: Unit besar yang memakan dua slot party.
heroes.notes_en: Large unit occupying two party slots.

heroes.name: Kuroto
heroes.recruit_id: Altverden Village — di depan salah satu rumah.
heroes.recruit_en: Altverden Village — in front of one of the houses.

heroes.name: Francesca
heroes.recruit_id: Altverden Village — di utara lokasi Kuroto, sedang diganggu preman.
heroes.recruit_en: Altverden Village — just north of Kuroto's spot, being harassed by ruffians.

heroes.name: Yusuke
heroes.recruit_id: Fort Xialuke — ajak bicara saat dia sedang diganggu penjaga.
heroes.recruit_en: Fort Xialuke — talk to him while he's being harassed by guards.

heroes.name: Gigina
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — direkrut saat kembali ke Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — recruited when you return to Arenside.

heroes.name: Sabine
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — setelah merekrut beberapa sekutu Watch, cek penginapan untuk bertemu Sabine.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — after recruiting some Watch allies, check the inn to meet Sabine.

heroes.name: Ymir
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung saat para penyintas berkumpul setelah Eltisweiss diserang.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins when survivors regroup after Eltisweiss is ransacked.

heroes.name: Sumire
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — salah satu penyintas yang bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — one of the survivors who joins.

heroes.name: Cassandra
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan baru.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the fledgling force.
heroes.notes_id: Support — ganti komposisi party di save point. HQ — penjaga penginapan.
heroes.notes_en: Support — change party composition at save points. HQ — innkeeper.

heroes.name: Kogen
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — setelah bertarung melawannya di Abandoned Mines, dia dan gengnya bergabung saat evakuasi Eltisweiss.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — after fighting him in the Abandoned Mines, he and his gang join during the Eltisweiss evacuation.

heroes.name: Yuthus
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung bersama Kogen dan Zabi.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins alongside Kogen and Zabi.

heroes.name: Zabi
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung bersama Kogen dan Yuthus.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins alongside Kogen and Yuthus.

heroes.name: Gocteau
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — penyintas yang bergabung di tahap ini.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — another survivor who joins at this stage.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — menjalankan mission guild (kirim karakter cari material), terbuka belakangan.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — runs the mission guild (send characters for materials), unlocked later.

heroes.name: Iris
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan kecil.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the small army.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — membuka bangunan dan upgrade baru dengan resource.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — unlocks new buildings and upgrades with resources.

heroes.name: Caine
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — direkrut bersama rombongan.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — recruited as part of the bunch.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — jual material berlebih untuk dana HQ.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — sell excess materials for HQ funds.

heroes.name: Martha
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — di timur reruntuhan plaza, bibi Nowa.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — east of the plaza ruins, Nowa's auntie.
heroes.notes_id: Support — tambah material dari node bahan makanan. Syarat bangun Pasturage.
heroes.notes_en: Support — more materials from food nodes. Required for Pasturage.

heroes.name: Ormond
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — lewat pintu belakang lantai 1 HQ (kuburan), turun ke sumur, lalu ke barat daya sampai pintu keluar tak bertanda.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — through the back door on HQ's first floor (graveyard), down the well, then southwest to an unmarked exit.
heroes.notes_id: Support — tambah resource dari deposit tambang. Mengelola Quarry.
heroes.notes_en: Support — more resources from mining deposits. Runs the Quarry.

heroes.name: Hiro
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di bagian pilar berputar; bisa direkrut setelah Town HQ Level 2.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the looping pillars section; recruitable after Town HQ Level 2.

heroes.name: Galdorf
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di ruang pertama (dari pintu world map); bawakan Paleknight Mail (loot di bekas lokasi Ormond atau Proving Grounds).
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the first chamber (from the world map entrance); bring a Paleknight Mail (looted where Ormond was, or in Proving Grounds).

heroes.name: Falward
heroes.recruit_id: Altverden Village — di dalam balai kota; berikan 15 Healing Herbs untuk menyembuhkan warga.
heroes.recruit_en: Altverden Village — inside the town hall; give 15 Healing Herbs to cure the townsfolk.

heroes.name: Frida
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village — mengelola kios di kiri nenek Yume.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village — managing her stall to the left of Yume's grandma.

heroes.name: Wyler
heroes.recruit_id: Bounty Hill — jelajahi area bawah untuk mencari adiknya Marin; setelah ketemu, keduanya bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Bounty Hill — explore the lower areas searching for his sister Marin; once found, both join.

heroes.name: Marin
heroes.recruit_id: Bounty Hill — bergabung bersama kakaknya Wyler.
heroes.recruit_en: Bounty Hill — joins alongside her brother Wyler.
heroes.notes_id: Healer jarak jauh. Support — sedikit tambah material dari semua node.
heroes.notes_en: Long-range healer. Support — slightly more materials from all nodes.

heroes.name: Kerrin
heroes.recruit_id: Dappled Forest — di gubuk penebang kayu sisi kanan pintu masuk; bawakan lumber agar mau bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Dappled Forest — inside a woodcutter's hut on the right as you enter; bring lumber to recruit her.
heroes.notes_id: Support — tambah material dari node kayu. Mengelola Woodcutter's Cabin.
heroes.notes_en: Support — more materials from logging nodes. Manages Woodcutter's Cabin.

heroes.name: Gieran
heroes.recruit_id: The Greatwood (East) — lawan monster sampai dapat Rune of Conservation sebagai loot.
heroes.recruit_en: The Greatwood (East) — battle monsters until you loot the Rune of Conservation.

heroes.name: Kallathor
heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — memimpin tim ke Greatwood; bergabung permanen setelah dungeon Proving Grounds selesai.
heroes.recruit_en: Treefolk Village — leads your team into the Greatwood; joins permanently after the Proving Grounds dungeon.

heroes.name: Chron
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — muncul di jalan utama kota setelah event Treefolk Village/Proving Grounds.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — appears on the town's main path after the Treefolk Village/Proving Grounds events.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — Achievement Society, melacak statistik (kill, damage, rekrutmen).
heroes.notes_en: HQ — Achievement Society, tracks stats (kills, damage, recruitment).

heroes.name: Squash
heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — di depan trading post; kembali ke Dappled Forest, lawan Phantombird sampai dapat Sparklestone.
heroes.recruit_en: Treefolk Village — in front of the trading post; return to Dappled Forest and fight Phantombirds until a Sparklestone drops.

heroes.name: Pastole
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — temui setelah Proving Grounds, lewat jalur Greatwood (South).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — meet after the Proving Grounds via the Greatwood (South) path.
heroes.notes_id: Support — tambah material dari titik buruan. Mengelola Hunter's Cabin.
heroes.notes_en: Support — more materials from hunting nodes. Runs Hunter's Cabin.

heroes.name: Mariette
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — dia kehilangan charm saat lari dari Rabbit Archwitch; kembali ke Greatwood (South), lawan Rabbit Archwitch dan loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — she lost her charm fleeing a Rabbit Archwitch; return to Greatwood (South), fight Rabbit Archwitches and loot chests with Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — pustakawan; cek bestiary dan kumpulkan Faded Books.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — librarian; check bestiary and collect Faded Books.

heroes.name: Perrielle
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bangsawan House Grum; resmi bergabung setelah negosiasi dengan pejabat Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — noble scion of House Grum; officially joins after negotiations with Hishahn officials.
heroes.notes_id: Healer jarak pendek. Support — buff attack dan action speed di awal battle.
heroes.notes_en: Short-range healer. Support — buffs party attack and action speed at battle start.

heroes.name: Janquis
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bergabung bersama Perrielle.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — joins alongside Perrielle.
heroes.notes_en: Support — doubles baqua earned from combat.

heroes.name: Kurtz
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di tengah kota, dia mencari resep; punya arc opsional dan mini-game cooking contest.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — at the city center, looking for a recipe; has his own optional arc and cooking minigame.
heroes.notes_id: Support — masak buff sebelum battle. HQ — menjalankan restoran/cook-off.
heroes.notes_en: Support — cooks pre-battle buffs. HQ — runs the restaurant/cook-offs.

heroes.name: Huang
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bergabung setelah berhasil menangkap ikan Wheel-eyed Bream yang sulit.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — joins once you catch the elusive Wheel-eyed Bream fish.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — required to build Fishing Spots.

heroes.name: Nell
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di belakang kios bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — behind the stall in the northwestern part of the city.
heroes.notes_id: Support — tambah kapasitas inventory (+20). Syarat bangun Stowpack Shop.
heroes.notes_en: Support — more inventory capacity (+20). Required for Stowpack Shop.

heroes.name: Riufan
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan kincir air; tantang dan kalahkan dia (butuh Nowa sekitar level 33).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of a waterwheel; challenge and defeat him (needs Nowa around level 33).

heroes.name: Carrie
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — membuka mekanik teleportasi/fast travel.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — unlocks the teleportation/fast travel mechanic.
heroes.notes_id: Healer jarak jauh. Sangat penting untuk fast travel.
heroes.notes_en: Long-range healer. Essential for fast travel.

heroes.name: Paquia
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — bersama Eggfoot-nya; kumpulkan 5 Plain Eggs (drop dari Eggfoot di world map luar HQ).
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — with her Eggfoot companion; collect 5 Plain Eggs (dropped by Eggfoots on the world map outside HQ).
heroes.notes_id: HQ — syarat bangun Racing Stables (balap & breeding Eggfoot).
heroes.notes_en: HQ — required for Racing Stables (Eggfoot racing & breeding).

heroes.name: Mandie
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — bergabung sekitar waktu yang sama dengan Paquia.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — joins around the same time as Paquia.
heroes.notes_id: Support — naikkan drop rate telur di battle.
heroes.notes_en: Support — increases egg drop rate in battles.

heroes.name: Glen
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — di rumah bagian barat; kalahkan dia dalam card match.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — at the house in the western part; beat him in a card match.

heroes.name: Pieter
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village — di bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village — in the northwestern part of town.
heroes.notes_id: HQ — syarat bangun Farm (panen makanan dan sayur).
heroes.notes_en: HQ — required for Farm (harvests food and vegetables).

heroes.name: Isha
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — karakter dari Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, di dekat air mancur plaza; selesaikan 3 tugasnya: cari kucing hilang (barat daya kota), dapatkan Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick), antar paket ke Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — a character from Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, by the plaza fountain; complete her 3 tasks: find the lost cat (southwest city), obtain a Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot chest with Attack/Gimmick), deliver a package to Arenside.

heroes.name: Douglas
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di toko pandai besi; berikan 10x Iron Ore.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — at the blacksmith's shop; give him 10x Iron Ore.
heroes.notes_id: Support — mengasah dan memperkuat senjata. HQ — menjalankan Smithy.
heroes.notes_en: Support — hones and strengthens weapons. HQ — runs the Smithy.

heroes.name: Larla
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di penginapan; kemungkinan bergabung setelah tim menyelesaikan misi dengan rating 'Critical Success'.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — at the inn; likely joins once a team completes a task with a 'Critical Success' rating.
heroes.notes_id: Mission Guild — stat lumayan untuk misi.

heroes.name: Maureus
heroes.recruit_id: Mountain Path Homeward — jalur barat laut; dia mencari anggota skuad yang kuat (butuh stat strength/magic tinggi, ~200).
heroes.recruit_en: Mountain Path Homeward — northwestern pathway; he's looking for a powerful squad member (needs high strength/magic, ~200).

heroes.name: Faye
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — terkait dengan bertemu B'baba dan memakai Divination Parlor.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — related to meeting B'baba and using the Divination Parlor.

heroes.name: B'baba
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — dia memberi petunjuk lokasi calon sekutu lain.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — she gives hints about other potential allies' whereabouts.

heroes.name: Melridge
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — direkrut setelah memenangkan army battle di Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — recruited upon winning the army battle at Hishahn.

heroes.name: Bernard
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung sekitar waktu yang sama dengan Melridge.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins around the same time as Melridge.

heroes.name: Seign
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — resmi bergabung dengan aliansi setelah event di Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — officially joins the alliance after the events at Hishahn.
heroes.notes_id: Petarung hybrid jarak pendek, salah satu protagonis.
heroes.notes_en: Short-range hybrid fighter, one of the protagonists.

heroes.name: Pohl
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung bersama skuad Seign.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins along with Seign's squad.

heroes.name: Valentin
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — letnan Seign yang selalu di sisinya.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — Seign's lieutenant, always by his side.

heroes.name: Hildi
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — menemani Seign di tahap ini.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — accompanies Seign at this stage.

heroes.name: Leon
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — di pintu keluar barat markas, terlihat terluka.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — at the western exit of your base, appearing injured.

heroes.name: Fume
heroes.recruit_id: Dappled Forest — muncul setelah Mission Guild dibangun dan bagian kedua Dappled Forest bisa dijelajahi.
heroes.recruit_en: Dappled Forest — appears once the Mission Guild is built and the second Dappled Forest section is traversable.
heroes.notes_id: Mission Guild — stat lumayan untuk misi.

heroes.name: Jorhan
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan trading post; bicara dengannya, lalu ke Shandar Ridge/gurun Dabavin, lawan Scarab sampai dapat Unknown Antique, appraisal untuk tahu itu Yellow Rose Censer, serahkan ke Jorhan.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of the trading post; talk to him, then go through Shandar Ridge to the Dabavin desert, fight Scarabs until an Unknown Antique drops, appraise it to reveal a Yellow Rose Censer, hand it to Jorhan.

heroes.name: Aire
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di dekat pintu keluar kiri bawah setelah event besar; tantang balapan (butuh speed Nowa ~165, pakai Rune of Swift Speed + Dash Boots).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — near the lower-left exit after major events; challenge her to a race (needs Nowa ~165 speed, use Rune of Swift Speed + Dash Boots).
heroes.notes_id: Support — gandakan movement speed (stack dengan Dash Boots).
heroes.notes_en: Support — doubles movement speed (stacks with Dash Boots).

heroes.name: Syd
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan toko pandai besi; baru mau bergabung setelah Town HQ level 3.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of the blacksmith's shop; only joins once Town HQ reaches level 3.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — required to build the Workshop.

heroes.name: Hakugin
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — datang dengan Mio di party.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — go with Mio in your party.
heroes.notes_id: Petarung hybrid jarak menengah yang sangat cepat.

heroes.name: Enoe
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — bergabung setelah Mission Guild Gocteau dibangun di HQ.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — joins once Gocteau's Mission Guild is built in your HQ.
heroes.notes_id: Mission Guild — stat bagus untuk misi.
heroes.notes_en: Mission Guild — great stats for missions.

heroes.name: Code L
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — di dalam Rune Shop, tunjukkan Rune of Currents (loot dari boss Hishahn Old Town).
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — inside the Rune Shop, show him a Rune of Currents (looted from the Hishahn Old Town boss).
heroes.notes_id: Support — bonus +1 SP di awal combat. HQ — mengelola Rune Shop.
heroes.notes_en: Support — +1 SP bonus at combat start. HQ — manages the Rune Shop.

heroes.name: Lam
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — PERINGATAN BUG: jangan masuk Daphan Village sebelum Riufan direkrut. Setelah Riufan direkrut, ajak bicara di penginapan HQ, lalu bawa Riufan di party saat pertama kali ke Daphan Village.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — BUG WARNING: don't enter Daphan Village before recruiting Riufan. After recruiting Riufan, talk to him at the HQ inn, then bring Riufan in your party on your first visit to Daphan Village.
heroes.notes_id: Missable — ikuti urutan dengan benar agar tidak kelewatan.
heroes.notes_en: Missable — follow the steps correctly to avoid missing her.

heroes.name: Reyna
heroes.recruit_id: Dabavin — fokus defensif; berikan damage besar padanya.
heroes.recruit_en: Dabavin — defense-focused; deal a ton of damage to her.

heroes.name: Prunella
heroes.recruit_id: Dabavin — kumpulkan minimal 100.000 baqua; bayar padanya (dia mengembalikan 50.000).
heroes.recruit_en: Dabavin — amass at least 100,000 baqua; pay her (she refunds 50,000).

heroes.name: Rody
heroes.recruit_id: Dabavin — ke Seaside Cavern, temukan Unknown Pocket Watch, appraisal lalu berikan padanya.
heroes.recruit_en: Dabavin — travel to the Seaside Cavern, find an Unknown Pocket Watch, have it appraised and give it to him.
heroes.notes_id: Support — naikkan action speed party. HQ — appraiser markas.
heroes.notes_en: Support — greatly increases party action speed. HQ — base appraiser.

heroes.name: Cabana
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — di bagian timur kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — at the eastern part of the city.
heroes.notes_id: Support — buff hot spring sebelum combat. HQ — mengelola hot springs.
heroes.notes_en: Support — pre-combat hot spring buffs. HQ — manages the hot springs.

heroes.name: Stadler
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — kalahkan dia dalam mock army battle.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — defeat him in a mock army battle.
heroes.notes_id: Support — opsi 'All In Formation' di awal battle. HQ — Drill Grounds.
heroes.notes_en: Support — 'All In Formation' option at battle start. HQ — Drill Grounds.

heroes.name: Quinn
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — selesaikan objektif utama Impershi'arc dengan Nowa level 37, ikuti quest-nya ke Den of the Dunes, kejar boss Oyamatsumi.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — complete the Impershi'arc main objective with Nowa at level 37, follow her quest to the Den of the Dunes, chase the Oyamatsumi boss.

heroes.name: Skyd
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — bergabung bersama Yuferius setelah balapan Shi'arc selesai.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — joins with Yuferius once the Shi'arc race is complete.

heroes.name: Yuferius
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — pelatih balap, bergabung setelah balapan Shi'arc.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — racing coach, joins after the Shi'arc race.

heroes.name: Scarlet
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — kapten sand ship Europhe; kalahkan dia dalam balapan.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — captain of the sand ship Europhe; beat her in a race.

heroes.name: Milana
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — muncul setelah membangun Rune Shop untuk Code L.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — appears after building the Rune Shop for Code L.
heroes.notes_id: Petarung hybrid jarak jauh; necromancer (bonus vs undead).
heroes.notes_en: Long-range hybrid fighter; necromancer (bonus vs undead).

heroes.name: Yaelu
heroes.recruit_id: Rune-Lens Research Laboratory — bergabung otomatis sebagai bagian arc Seign.
heroes.recruit_en: Rune-Lens Research Laboratory — joins automatically as part of Seign's arc.
heroes.notes_id: Petarung melee jarak menengah. Support — kurangi random encounter.
heroes.notes_en: Medium-range melee fighter. Support — reduces random encounters.

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.recruit_id: Rune-Lens Research Laboratory — bergabung bersama Yaelu.
heroes.recruit_en: Rune-Lens Research Laboratory — joins alongside Yaelu.
heroes.notes_id: Petarung/tank melee jarak pendek. Support — tambah kapasitas resource bag.
heroes.notes_en: Short-range melee fighter/tank. Support — more resource bag capacity.

heroes.name: Clarke
heroes.recruit_id: Ardinale City — dia mencari drama yang penuh passion (collectible).
heroes.recruit_en: Ardinale City — he's looking for a play with a lot of passion (a collectible).

heroes.name: Dalton
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — cukup ajak bicara untuk bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — just talk to him to recruit.

heroes.name: Durlan
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mines — lewat sumur di belakang lantai 1 HQ, terus ke kiri dan bawah terowongan sempit; butuh Town HQ Level 3 dan Mission Guild ter-upgrade.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mines — via the well behind HQ's first floor, keep left and down the narrow tunnels; needs Town HQ Level 3 and upgraded Mission Guild.
heroes.notes_id: Mission Guild — stat lumayan untuk misi.

heroes.name: Milhu
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung di akhir mini-arc Seign.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins at the conclusion of Seign's mini-arc.

heroes.name: Marisa
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — protagonis utama; bergabung setelah arc Ardinale Seign selesai.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — major protagonist; joins once Seign's Ardinale arc is done.

heroes.name: Garoo
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung permanen bersama Marisa.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins permanently with Marisa.

heroes.name: CJ
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ/Runebarrows — karakter Rising ketiga; rekrut di Runebarrows.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ/Runebarrows — the third Rising character; recruit at the Runebarrows.

heroes.name: Aleior
heroes.recruit_id: MISSABLE — Bawa Marisa (lantai 1 HQ), bicara dengan pemuda di desa atap runcing (Altverden Village), lalu temukan griffin di Abandoned Mines (pintu utama, ke utara sampai buntu, lalu timur). Kerjakan SEGERA setelah Marisa bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: MISSABLE — Bring Marisa (HQ first floor), talk to the young man in the peaked-roof village (Altverden Village), then find the griffin in the Abandoned Mines (main entrance, north to the dead end, then east). Do this IMMEDIATELY after Marisa joins.
heroes.notes_id: ⚠️ Missable — unit monster jarak jauh, 2 slot.

heroes.name: Goldsmid
heroes.recruit_id: Yarnaan — lantai 2; dia mencari orang yang cukup kuat (party ~200+ strength). PENTING: rekrut saat kunjungan pertama Nowa ke Yarnaan, karena insiden cerita akan menutup akses ke kota untuk sementara.
heroes.recruit_en: Yarnaan — second floor; he's looking for someone strong enough (party ~200+ strength). IMPORTANT: recruit during Nowa's first visit to Yarnaan, as a story incident will block access to the town for a while.

heroes.name: Alwe
heroes.recruit_id: Yarnaan — bergabung sebagai bagian cerita setelah bicara dengan elder Yarnaan.
heroes.recruit_en: Yarnaan — joins as part of the story after talking to the Yarnaan elder.

heroes.name: Nil
heroes.recruit_id: Yarnaan — bergabung sekitar waktu yang sama dengan Alwe.
heroes.recruit_en: Yarnaan — joins around the same time as Alwe.

heroes.name: Chandra
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ/Eldroad — bicara dengan prajurit di drill grounds HQ (Code L berkomentar soal naga), bawa Code L sebagai support ke Eldroad, ikuti jalan berliku, naga di kanan reruntuhan sebelum jembatan; kalahkan naga itu.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ/Eldroad — talk to soldiers at the HQ drill grounds (Code L remarks about the dragon), bring Code L as support to the Eldroad, follow the winding path, the dragon is right of a ruined building before the bridge; defeat it.

heroes.name: Rudy
heroes.recruit_id: Skriss Village/Ice Cave — selamatkan anak-anak di Ice Cave sebagai bagian main quest.
heroes.recruit_en: Skriss Village/Ice Cave — rescue the children in the Ice Cave as part of a main quest.

heroes.name: Selbineth
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — capai HQ level 3, bangun Mysterious Room (masuk dari penjara bawah tanah); di dalamnya ada kamar Selbineth.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — reach HQ level 3, build the Mysterious Room (enter from the underground prison); inside is Selbineth's chamber.
heroes.notes_en: HQ — unlocks the boss rush feature.

heroes.name: Lilwn
heroes.recruit_id: Yarnaan — direkrut saat kembali ke Yarnaan sebagai bagian cerita.
heroes.recruit_en: Yarnaan — recruited when revisiting Yarnaan as part of the story.

heroes.name: Euma
heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — lord Hishahn yang plin-plan; resmi jadi sekutu saat cerita sampai Atrabalt.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — the indecisive lord of Hishahn; officially becomes an ally once the story reaches Atrabalt.
heroes.notes_en: Support — volley fire from Euchrissian archers.

heroes.name: Kassius
heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — bergabung saat tuannya (Euma) bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — joins when his liege lord (Euma) does.

heroes.name: Foxiel
heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — di pasar timur depan kios; saat dia mendeskripsikan makanan, kembali ke restoran HQ, bicara dengan Kurtz untuk memasak Vegetable Milk Soup, serahkan padanya.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — at the eastern marketplace in front of a stall; when she describes a food, return to the HQ restaurant, speak with Kurtz to cook Vegetable Milk Soup, hand it to her.

heroes.name: Wayve
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — saat kunjungan ke Snowpeak Pass.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — during the Snowpeak Pass visit.

heroes.name: Yulin
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — bergabung otomatis karena event di Atrabalt dan Twinhorne West.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — joins automatically due to events in Atrabalt and Twinhorne West.
heroes.notes_id: Support — gandakan EXP dari combat. TITIK AMAN untuk rekrut sisanya.
heroes.notes_en: Support — doubles EXP from combat. SAFE POINT to recruit the rest.

heroes.name: Rohan
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di penginapan, ajak bicara.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — at the inn, talk to him.
heroes.notes_id: Support — pulihkan 20% HP party otomatis setelah combat.
heroes.notes_en: Support — auto-restores 20% party HP after combat.

heroes.name: Hogan
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di dermaga; dia ingin kamu dapat minimal 50.000 baqua murni dari trading post (beli murah jual mahal: beli lukisan/ukiran di Ardinale City, jual lukisan di Hishahn, ukiran di Impershi'arc).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — by the pier; he wants you to earn at least 50,000 baqua purely from trading posts (buy low sell high: buy paintings/carvings in Ardinale City, sell paintings in Hishahn, carvings in Impershi'arc).
heroes.notes_id: Support — negosiasi kabur dari battle. HQ — buka trading post.
heroes.notes_en: Support — negotiate battle escape. HQ — opens a trading post.

heroes.name: Momo
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn/Seaside Cavern — di selatan jembatan toko Hishahn; selesaikan personal quest-nya di Seaside Caverns (buka barrier, kalahkan boss Kraken dengan Gimmick: turunkan air, pakai harpoon).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn/Seaside Cavern — south of the Hishahn shop bridge; complete his personal quest in the Seaside Caverns (unlock the barrier, defeat the Kraken boss using Gimmicks: lower water, use harpoon).

heroes.name: Aoi
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — kembali dengan Iugo di party; kendalikan Iugo untuk mengalahkannya satu lawan satu.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — return with Iugo in your party; control Iugo to defeat her one-on-one.

heroes.name: El Alicanto
heroes.recruit_id: Snowpeak Pass — ambil jalur utara sampai bagian yang dulu tertutup cutscene; kalahkan dia dalam duel.
heroes.recruit_en: Snowpeak Pass — take the northern path to the section previously blocked by a cutscene; defeat him in a duel.

heroes.name: Allaby
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — setelah Markus muncul dan chapter berikutnya, ke penginapan dan ajak bicara.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — after Markus appears and the next chapter, head to the inn and talk to her.
heroes.notes_id: Support — ganti musik battle. HQ — auditorium untuk dengar track.
heroes.notes_en: Support — changes battle music. HQ — auditorium to listen to tracks.

heroes.name: Galladur
heroes.recruit_id: Proving Grounds — menangkan battle.
heroes.recruit_en: Proving Grounds — win the battle.

heroes.name: Shixeen
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — butuh HQ level 3 + upgrade Card Shop; kumpulkan kartu karakter bintang 4 dari Extra Pack 1-3; dia muncul tiba-tiba, kalahkan dalam card match.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — needs HQ level 3 + Card Shop upgrades; collect 4-star character cards from Extra Packs 1-3; she appears suddenly, defeat her in a card match.

heroes.name: Celia
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung setelah menyelesaikan sebagian besar cooking challenge.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins after completing most of the cooking challenges.

heroes.name: Dijkstra
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — terima misinya (petunjuk Divination Parlor salah bilang Twinhorne West); pergi ke dungeon Chelonian Goliath Vilashnu, resmi bergabung setelah boss Goblomancer dan Letus.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — accept his mission (Divination Parlor clue wrongly says Twinhorne West); go to the Chelonian Goliath Vilashnu dungeon, officially joins after the Goblomancer and Letus boss fight.

heroes.name: Reid
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di barat daya kota; tantang dan kalahkan beberapa pemain Beigoma untuk merekrutnya.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — in the southwestern city; challenge and defeat multiple Beigoma players to recruit him.

heroes.name: Dr. Corque
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — masuk ke rumahnya di selatan kota setelah bicara dengan Reid; kemungkinan terkait koleksi Beigoma langka.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — enter his home in the southern city after talking to Reid; likely involves collecting rare Beigoma tops.

heroes.name: Markus
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — lich lord; bergabung di akhir arc Atrabalt.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — the lich lord; joins at the conclusion of the Atrabalt arc.
heroes.notes_id: Penyihir jarak jauh; necromancer (bonus vs undead).

heroes.name: Lakian
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung sebagai bagian cerita.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins as part of the story.

heroes.name: Goldwyn
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung setelah mengusir pasukan kekaisaran yang menyerang markas.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins after routing the imperial forces invading your domain.

heroes.name: Elektra
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — dari Atrabalt, bergabung di tahap ini bersama Maxim.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — from Atrabalt, joins at this stage with Maxim.

heroes.name: Maxim
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — mengikuti Elektra ke mana pun dia pergi.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — follows his beloved Elektra wherever she goes.

heroes.name: Vorrdice
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bersumpah setia ke pasukan resistance di tahap ini.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — pledges allegiance to the resistance forces at this stage.

heroes.name: Viesskin
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — membantu Jenderal Vorrdice.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — aids General Vorrdice.

heroes.name: Leene
heroes.recruit_id: MISSABLE — petunjuk Divination Parlor: jalan lain terbuka setelah semuanya 'terkumpul'. Butuh 119 hero lain sebelum mengalahkan Dux Aldric.
heroes.recruit_en: MISSABLE — Divination Parlor clue: another path opens once everything is 'collected'. Requires the other 119 heroes before defeating Dux Aldric.
heroes.notes_id: ⚠️ Missable — karakter terakhir untuk true ending 120 hero.
heroes.notes_en: ⚠️ Missable — the final character for the 120-hero true ending.

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa's first mission as a Watch member begins in Arenside Village. Here you learn the basics of combat and exploration while meeting your new comrades.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi pertama Nowa sebagai anggota Watch dimulai di Desa Arenside. Di sini kamu belajar dasar bertarung dan menjelajah sambil berkenalan dengan rekan-rekan barumu.
walkthrough.title: First Mission — Arenside Village

walkthrough.summary_en: The Watch's first official mission takes you into the Northern Forest to locate the Runebarrows. Watch out for wild monsters and ancient traps inside the ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi resmi pertama Watch membawamu ke Hutan Utara untuk menemukan Runebarrows. Waspadalah terhadap monster liar dan jebakan kuno di dalam reruntuhan.
walkthrough.title: Into the Barrows — Northern Forest

walkthrough.summary_en: Explore the depths of the Northern Runebarrows alongside Seign. The mystery of the Primal Lens starts to unfold, but far greater dangers hide in the ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Jelajahi kedalaman Northern Runebarrows bersama Seign. Misteri Primal Lens mulai terkuak, tapi reruntuhannya menyimpan bahaya yang jauh lebih besar.
walkthrough.title: Search the Barrows — Northern Runebarrows

walkthrough.summary_en: Six months have passed and Nowa is now the Watch Captain. Your first assignment sends you around the town of Eltisweiss handling the locals' problems.
walkthrough.summary_id: Enam bulan berlalu dan Nowa kini menjabat Kapten Watch. Tugas pertamamu membawamu berkeliling kota Eltisweiss dan menangani masalah para warga.
walkthrough.title: The Watch Captain's First Job — Eltisweiss

walkthrough.summary_en: Bandits are troubling Altverden and their trail leads to the Abandoned Mine. Delve through its dark tunnels and deal with the criminals.
walkthrough.summary_id: Para bandit meresahkan Altverden dan jejaknya mengarah ke Tambang Terbengkalai. Susuri terowongan gelapnya dan bereskan para penjahat itu.
walkthrough.title: Searching the Tunnels — Abandoned Mine

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa returns to Kyshiri Village, his hometown. The nostalgic visit does not last long before new trouble appears.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa pulang ke Desa Kyshiri, kampung halamannya. Kunjungan penuh nostalgia ini tidak bertahan lama sebelum masalah baru muncul.
walkthrough.title: Homecoming — Kyshiri

walkthrough.summary_en: A stealth mission into an Imperial camp begins at Werne Village. Move silently and gather intel without being spotted by the enemy.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi penyusupan ke kamp Kekaisaran dimulai dari Desa Werne. Bergeraklah dalam diam dan kumpulkan informasi tanpa ketahuan musuh.
walkthrough.title: Infiltrate the Empire — Werne Village

walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire is preparing a major assault on Eltisweiss. Ready the town's defenses and face the incoming waves of enemy troops.
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran bersiap melancarkan serangan besar ke Eltisweiss. Siapkan pertahanan kota dan hadapi gelombang pasukan musuh yang datang.
walkthrough.title: The Eltisweiss Front — Eltisweiss

walkthrough.summary_en: After the battle, it is time to rebuild from Castle HQ. The Alliance officially forms and headquarters construction begins from its ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Usai pertempuran, saatnya membangun kembali dari Kastil HQ. Aliansi resmi terbentuk dan pembangunan markas dimulai dari reruntuhannya.
walkthrough.title: Hoist the Alliance Banner — Castle HQ

walkthrough.summary_en: The perspective shifts to Marisa, who wakes up in the mysterious Yarnaan. Explore the unfamiliar village and find out what is really going on.
walkthrough.summary_id: Sudut pandang beralih ke Marisa yang tersadar di Yarnaan yang misterius. Jelajahi desa asing ini dan cari tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.
walkthrough.title: In an Unknown Village — Yarnaan

walkthrough.summary_en: Meet the Treefolk in the Greatwood and learn about their culture. Diplomacy here is vital for expanding the Alliance.
walkthrough.summary_id: Bertemu kaum Treefolk di Greatwood dan pelajari budaya mereka. Diplomasi di sini sangat penting untuk memperluas Aliansi.
walkthrough.title: The Village of the Treefolk — Greatwood

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Marisa investigate a newly discovered Runebarrows while searching for Leene, Nowa's missing sister. Heavy trials already await inside.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Marisa menyelidiki Runebarrows yang baru ditemukan sambil mencari Leene, kakak Nowa yang hilang. Ujian berat sudah menanti di dalam.
walkthrough.title: The Proving Grounds — Proving Grounds

walkthrough.summary_en: Travel to Euchrisse, the land of water, to reunite with Lady Perrielle. Alliance negotiations turn out to be trickier than expected.
walkthrough.summary_id: Perjalanan ke Euchrisse, negeri air, untuk bertemu kembali dengan Lady Perrielle. Negosiasi aliansi ternyata tidak semudah yang dibayangkan.
walkthrough.title: Euchrisse, the Land of Water — South Greatwood

walkthrough.summary_en: Investigate Harlan, King Euma's advisor, in the flooded Hishahn Old Town. Expose his schemes before it is all too late.
walkthrough.summary_id: Selidiki Harlan, penasihat Raja Euma, di Kota Tua Hishahn yang tergenang banjir. Bongkar rencananya sebelum semuanya terlambat.
walkthrough.title: Reveal Harlan's Schemes! — Hishahn Old Town

walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire invades Hishahn and the city must be defended. Lead the Alliance forces in a fierce battle.
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran menyerbu Hishahn dan kota ini harus dipertahankan. Pimpin pasukan Aliansi dalam pertempuran yang sengit.
walkthrough.title: The Hishahn Front — Hishahn

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Barnard cross the desert toward Shandar Ridge to recruit new allies. The desert journey is full of danger.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Barnard menyeberangi gurun menuju Shandar Ridge untuk merekrut sekutu baru. Perjalanan gurunnya penuh bahaya.
walkthrough.title: New Forces — Shandar Ridge

walkthrough.summary_en: Enter a contest at Impershi'arc to win the loyalty of the Shi'arcs. Win with clever strategy, not just brute strength.
walkthrough.summary_id: Ikuti kontes di Impershi'arc untuk memenangkan kesetiaan kaum Shi'arc. Menangkan dengan strategi cerdik, bukan sekadar kekuatan.
walkthrough.title: Shi'arcs of a Scale — Impershi'arc

walkthrough.summary_en: Seign's side investigates a Rune-Lens research laboratory. This mission shows the Imperial perspective along with the secrets behind the lens.
walkthrough.summary_id: Pihak Seign menyelidiki laboratorium penelitian Rune-Lens. Misi ini menampilkan sudut pandang Kekaisaran sekaligus rahasia di balik lens.
walkthrough.title: The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory

walkthrough.summary_en: Seek allies in the western nation of Norristar via Eldroad. Diplomacy between nations will decide the Alliance's future.
walkthrough.summary_id: Cari sekutu di bangsa barat Norristar melalui Eldroad. Diplomasi antar bangsa akan menentukan masa depan Aliansi.
walkthrough.title: To Norristar, the Western Nation — Eldroad

walkthrough.summary_en: Rescue the lost children, then follow their trail into the Ice Cave. The freezing cave hides dangerous monsters.
walkthrough.summary_id: Selamatkan anak-anak yang tersesat lalu ikuti jejak mereka masuk ke Gua Es. Dinginnya gua menyimpan monster-monster berbahaya.
walkthrough.title: In the Land of Snow — Ice Cave

walkthrough.summary_en: The Alliance hatches a secret plan to slow the Imperial advance at Snowpeak Pass. Precise execution is the key to success.
walkthrough.summary_id: Aliansi menyusun rencana rahasia untuk memperlambat laju Kekaisaran di Snowpeak Pass. Eksekusi yang tepat menjadi kunci keberhasilan.
walkthrough.title: A Secret Plan — Snowpeak Pass

walkthrough.summary_en: Defend Athrabalt, the capital of Norristar, from the Imperial onslaught. This becomes one of the biggest battles of the war.
walkthrough.summary_id: Pertahankan Athrabalt, ibu kota Norristar, dari gempuran Kekaisaran. Ini menjadi salah satu pertempuran terbesar dalam perang.
walkthrough.title: The Athrabalt Front — Athrabalt

walkthrough.summary_en: The end of the war draws near across multiple locations. Gather all of your remaining strength for the decisive battles.
walkthrough.summary_id: Akhir perang semakin dekat di berbagai lokasi. Kumpulkan seluruh kekuatan terakhirmu untuk pertempuran yang menentukan.
walkthrough.title: The Final Battle! — Various

walkthrough.summary_en: Marisa and the Guardians unite with an unexpected ally to fight the Revenants at Castle Harganthia.
walkthrough.summary_id: Marisa dan para Guardian bersatu dengan sekutu yang tak terduga untuk melawan para Revenant di Kastil Harganthia.
walkthrough.title: An Unexpected Ally — Castle Harganthia

walkthrough.summary_en: The final confrontation with the Dux at Gardhaven Castle to end the war. Everything you have built leads to this point.
walkthrough.summary_id: Konfrontasi terakhir melawan Dux di Kastil Gardhaven untuk mengakhiri perang. Semua yang kamu bangun bermuara di titik ini.
walkthrough.title: Gardhaven Castle — Gardhaven Castle

details_en: Starts in Eltisweiss — find Reid in the southwest
First tops come from Dr. Corque's house in the southeast
60 tops from monster drops and beating trainers
Beat the trainers: Taq, Fender, Celera, Venom, Thudd, Zeph, Flowe, Pyre, Crash
Recruits Dr. Corque and Reid to your HQ
details_id: Mulai di Eltisweiss — temui Reid di bagian barat daya
Gasing pertama dari rumah Dr. Corque di tenggara
60 gasing dari drop monster dan mengalahkan pelatih
Kalahkan para pelatih: Taq, Fender, Celera, Venom, Thudd, Zeph, Flowe, Pyre, Crash
Merekrut Dr. Corque dan Reid ke markasmu
minigames.summary_en: Spinning-top battles in an arena: launch your top, use Boost to strike from the arena's edge, and win Clashes with button-mashing speed. Elements counter each other in a cycle: Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Earth, Earth beats Water, Water beats Fire.
minigames.summary_id: Pertarungan gasing di arena: luncurkan gasingmu, pakai Boost untuk menyerang dari tepi arena, dan menangkan Clash dengan adu kecepatan menekan tombol. Elemen saling mengalahkan: Api mengalahkan Angin, Angin mengalahkan Tanah, Tanah mengalahkan Air, Air mengalahkan Api.

details_en: Locations: Werne Village, Treefolk Village, Hishahn, Twinhorne East
Carrie unlocks fast travel between trading posts
Fast money for buying runes and gear
details_id: Lokasi: Werne Village, Treefolk Village, Hishahn, Twinhorne East
Carrie membuka fast travel antar pos dagang
Cara cepat dapat uang untuk beli rune dan perlengkapan
minigames.summary_en: Buy low and sell high across towns: blue up arrows mean the price is cheap, red down arrows mean it is expensive. Prices keep shifting over time, so time your trades well.
minigames.summary_id: Jual-beli antar kota: beli murah, jual mahal. Panah biru ke atas berarti harga sedang murah, panah merah ke bawah berarti mahal. Harga terus berubah seiring waktu, jadi atur timing dagangmu.

details_en: Bring new recipes to Kurtz to learn them
"How to Obtain" hints help you track down recipes
Cooking Battle: serve a 3-course meal to 4 judges
A 45-second button-mashing round to cheer the judges
Match dishes to each judge's favorite food for maximum score
details_id: Bawa resep baru ke Kurtz untuk mempelajarinya
Petunjuk "How to Obtain" membantu melacak resep
Cooking Battle: hidangkan 3 course untuk 4 juri
Ronde 45 detik adu tekan tombol untuk menyemangati juri
Sesuaikan masakan dengan makanan favorit tiap juri untuk skor maksimal
minigames.summary_en: Cook dishes with healing and buff effects. Recruit Kurtz and build a kitchen at the HQ Inn, then learn new recipes by bringing them back to him.
minigames.summary_id: Masak hidangan dengan efek penyembuh dan buff. Rekrut Kurtz dan bangun dapur di Penginapan HQ, lalu pelajari resep baru dengan membawanya kembali kepadanya.

details_en: Fishing spots are marked by blue rod icons near water
A Wheel Eye Bream is needed to recruit Huang in Hishahn
Your catches become cooking ingredients in Kurtz's kitchen
details_id: Titik memancing ditandai ikon joran biru di dekat air
Wheel Eye Bream dibutuhkan untuk merekrut Huang di Hishahn
Hasil tangkapanmu jadi bahan masakan di dapur Kurtz
minigames.summary_en: Gather cooking ingredients by fishing. Meet Huang in Arenside near the bridge during "Captain's First Watch" to receive the Bamboo Rod.
minigames.summary_id: Kumpulkan bahan masakan dengan memancing. Temui Huang di Arenside dekat jembatan saat misi "Captain's First Watch" untuk mendapatkan Bamboo Rod.

details_en: Race, customize, feed, breed, and retire your Eggfoots
Racing rewards fruits that grant random skills
Match your Eggfoot to the track's terrain and obstacles
details_id: Balapan, kustomisasi, beri makan, kawinkan, dan pensiunkan Eggfoot-mu
Hadiah balapan berupa buah yang memberi skill acak
Sesuaikan Eggfoot-mu dengan medan dan rintangan lintasan
minigames.summary_en: Race and breed the round Eggfoot creatures. Recruit Paquia and Mandie, then build the Eggfoot Stables west of the castle.
minigames.summary_id: Balapan dan kawinkan makhluk bundar Eggfoot. Rekrut Paquia dan Mandie, lalu bangun Kandang Eggfoot di barat kastil.

details_en: Actor personality affects the performance; Clarke notes who fits which role
Scripts: Red Riding Hood (Kyshiri), Cinderella (Treefolk Village, 30,000 baqua)
Scripts: Forest Musicians (Yarnaan, 15,000 baqua), Rising (Eltisweiss, 40,000 baqua)
Bring scripts to Iris; the audience rates the show at the end
details_id: Kepribadian aktor memengaruhi pentas; Clarke memberi catatan siapa cocok peran apa
Naskah: Red Riding Hood (Kyshiri), Cinderella (Treefolk Village, 30.000 baqua)
Naskah: Forest Musicians (Yarnaan, 15.000 baqua), Rising (Eltisweiss, 40.000 baqua)
Bawa naskah ke Iris; penonton memberi rating di akhir pentas
minigames.summary_en: Stage plays together with the townspeople. Recruit Clarke and build the theater west of town, then cast your party members as actors.
minigames.summary_id: Pentas sandiwara bersama warga kota. Rekrut Clarke dan bangun teater di barat kota, lalu pilih anggota party-mu sebagai aktor.

details_en: Enter through the glowing teleportation rock, then the glowing red portal
Choose a challenge mode; more modes unlock as you progress
Rewards: fast EXP for your party
details_id: Masuk lewat batu teleportasi bercahaya, lalu portal merah bercahaya

details_en: 160 cards in total once the shop is fully upgraded
Cards have colors, numbers, and character skills

Score points and crowns from combos: numerical order, same color, same number

Tiap ronde: buang 1, mainkan 1, letakkan 3
Skor poin dan mahkota dari kombo: urutan angka, warna sama, angka sama

minigames.summary_id: Permainan kartu berbasis deck bersama Glen. Bangun toko kartu, rekrut Glen, susun deck-mu, dan beli pack kartu baru.

guides.summary_id: Focus on HQ building from the start: rush the Drafting Studio, Resource Depot, and resource-generating buildings so upgrades never stall.
guides.summary_en: Fokus bangun HQ sejak awal: kejar Drafting Studio, Resource Depot, dan bangunan penghasil resource agar upgrade tidak macet.
details: Prioritaskan Drafting Studio, Resource Depot, & Logging Mill sejak awal
Jangan abaikan bangunan penghasil resource atau bakal grinding kayu/batu berjam-jam
Cek toko item tiap 30 menit untuk rare item
details_en: Prioritize Drafting Studio, Resource Depot, & Logging Mill early
Don't ignore resource buildings or you'll grind lumber/stone for hours
Check item shops every 30 minutes for rare stock

guides.summary_id: Three characters that can be permanently missed: Aleior (tight time window via Marisa), Lam (quest bug if talked to too early), and Leene (needs the other 119 heroes).
guides.summary_en: Tiga karakter yang bisa gagal direkrut permanen: Aleior (window waktu sempit via Marisa), Lam (bug quest jika diajak bicara terlalu dini), dan Leene (butuh 119 hero lain).
details: Aleior: bicaralah dengan Marisa di lantai 1 kastil sebelum ia pindah/misi
Lam: JANGAN ajak bicara dulu di Daphan Village sebelum quest Riufan dimulai
Leene butuh 119 hero lain sebelum event pertahanan kastil
details_en: Aleior: talk to Marisa on castle 1F before she moves/goes on mission
Lam: do NOT talk to her in Daphan Village before Riufan's quest starts
Leene needs the other 119 heroes before the castle defense event

guides.summary_id: Recruit all 120 heroes before the castle defense event to unlock Leene and the true ending.
guides.summary_en: Rekrut semua 120 hero sebelum event pertahanan kastil untuk membuka Leene dan true ending.
details: Tanpa 120 hero, ending final jauh lebih suram
Leene adalah hero ke-120; ia muncul setelah pertahanan kastil jika roster penuh
HQ level & fast travel ikut terkunci di balik rekrutmen
details_en: Without all 120 heroes, the final ending is much bleaker
Leene is hero #120; she appears after the castle defense if the roster is full
HQ level & fast travel are also gated behind recruitment

details_en: Use the Divination Parlor to track hero locations

Visit every corner of the map before major war battles

guides.summary_id: Exploit goods price differences across towns and times for fast baqua.

details_en: Buy cheap in one town, sell high in another town/time
